title: Fix it: add a delivery timestamp only to shipments that have been delivered
basics: A field can be made conditional by wrapping the key-value pair in parentheses and adding `if`: `{ id: 1, (note: "x") if flag }`. When the condition is false the key is left out entirely, which is different from writing it with a null value.
prompt:
The script in the editor is **almost** right. It passes on the sample and fails on a case you cannot see.

The original task was:

The carrier sends scan events as `{ id, status, ts }`, where `ts` is the time of the latest scan. The customer portal wants `{ id, status }` for every shipment, plus `deliveredAt` holding `ts`, but **only** for shipments whose status is `"delivered"`.

Other shipments must not have a `deliveredAt` key at all, not even a null one.

Find what is wrong and fix it. You can press Run to see what it currently does.
starter:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map { id: $.id, status: $.status, (deliveredAt: $.ts) if ($.ts != null) }
hints: Run it on the sample first. If the sample looks right, the bug only shows on data the sample does not contain.
Ask what kind of input would break this — an empty list, a missing field, a value ordered differently.
conditions on the timestamp being present, but every scan has a timestamp, not just deliveries
solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map { id: $.id, status: $.status, (deliveredAt: $.ts) if ($.status == "delivered") }

mustFail.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map { id: $.id, status: $.status, (deliveredAt: $.ts) if ($.ts != null) }

explanation.approach: Only the parenthesised form leaves a key out. A value of null is still a key, and a portal that checks "does deliveredAt exist" will treat that shipment as delivered. The condition also has to be the business rule, the status, rather than whatever field happens to be present.

snippets.label: A null value is still a field
snippets.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
{ id: 2, deliveredAt: if (false) "x" else null }
